paragraphs: Laos is my hometown, and Li Po Chun United World College in Hong Kong is where I learned to hike my way out of problems. Fast forward to now: I live in a small apartment in Norman, Oklahoma, learning everything I can about electronics and hardware design.

I'm an electrical engineering student at the University of Oklahoma. I made the switch from engineering physics to EE because I want to understand every level of abstraction in a circuit, from the device physics to the layout, which is what drives me to pursue integrated circuits and hardware design.
